working_title: Training data scale reference standards and the transportability of chest radiograph models
primary_loss: Unweighted masked BCE; no subset-dependent positive-class weights
validation: All available source-only frontal validation images, fixed across scales and seeds
early_stopping: Source macro-AUROC improvement greater than 0.001 resets patience; six failed checks after at least 5000 updates and at least two learning-rate reductions. Reaching maximum updates is reported as a cap, not convergence.
learning_rate_schedule: Convergence: ReduceLROnPlateau, factor 0.2, patience 2, absolute threshold 0.001, minimum 1e-6. Matched: fixed cosine after 500-update warmup, minimum 1e-6.
image_handling: 224 by 224 RGB bilinear resize, horizontal flip p=0.5, rotation plus/minus 5 degrees, ImageNet normalization; strict image decode; no blank replacements
sampler: Successive patient-defined nested subsets; shuffled image permutations concatenated across boundaries to produce exactly 32 images per optimizer update; no dropped tail
architecture_control: ImageNet ResNet-34 at 1000, 10000 and all, seeds 1,2,3; no CXR-pretrained foundation model in primary comparisons
pilot_scope: After technical completion checks of the initial source-only runs, execute 18 fixed-budget and 18 ResNet-34 controls. No test performance is used to permit continuation.

test_status.vindr_3000: Locked pending historical-use audit and resolution of author uncertainty; labels/performance are not accessed by this protocol's preparation or source training
test_status.vindr_15000: Previously evaluated development benchmark; never described as a new untouched test cohort

primary_estimand_proposed: Smallest-to-full mean seed-paired macro-AUROC difference separately for each training source on the official VinDr consensus test; confirmatory status depends on documented test independence
uncertainty: Use identical test resampling weights for paired model contrasts. Report image-sampling intervals separately from between-seed SD. VinDr image identifiers cannot establish patient independence. Primary two-source comparisons use 97.5% percentile intervals for familywise Bonferroni coverage plus descriptive 95% intervals. Seed resampling is a sensitivity analysis, not additional hospitals.
secondary_endpoint: Pleural-effusion sensitivity and specificity at a locked source-development threshold targeting 90% sensitivity; target threshold re-estimation is a separate strategy. No hospital-workload claim.
reference_analysis: Compare any-reader, majority-reader and all-reader aggregation on exactly the same 15000 released development images. None is newly adjudicated ground truth. Preserve original per-reader labels and report agreement and event counts.
target_adaptation_development: Reuse previously defined 20%/80% VinDr development split with unchanged salt ldh-2026. Nested random calibration samples 250,500,1000,2000; 20 sampling seeds. Ridge logistic calibration on clipped logits (C=1) only when at least 5 positives and 5 negatives; otherwise report non-fit. Compare raw score, constant prevalence estimated on calibration sample, calibrated probability and target-derived threshold; no test outcome is used for fitting.
composition_intervention: Planned fixed 20000-image samples at CheXpert:NIH 100:0,75:25,50:50,25:75,0:100, same update budget. Labels remain source-dependent; no pure institution effect claim. Train membership remains patient isolated.
label_quality_intervention: Not yet available; reader aggregation and synthetic corruption are not substitutes for paired expert correction of training labels.
analysis_status: Internal dated protocol, not preregistration. Earlier benchmark analyses remain post hoc. Substantive protocol changes require a new version and recorded reason before final test access.
reproducibility_amendment: Dedicated DataLoader generators isolate iterator creation from augmentation RNG; checkpoint-resume trajectory tested. First unfinished v1 run archived before any validation result or external evaluation.
matched_primary_checkpoint: last.pt at exactly 20000 actual optimizer updates; source-selected best.pt is secondary only
